summary.text: LAUKVIK BUTIKKDRIFT AS is a private limited company registered in Laukvik, founded 2019-12-19. LAUKVIK BUTIKKDRIFT AS sells groceries in a shop, and its statutory purpose covers the trading of groceries, customer services, postal services and other services with a natural connection to this. Its main industry code is 47.110: non-specialised retail sale of predominately food, beverages or tobacco. The register shows 5 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 7 427 439 NOK and the annual result was 111 382 NOK; operating income was down from 7 709 650 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 203 139 NOK in 2024 to 111 382 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 765 868 NOK in 2024 to 817 251 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 6 on 2025-11-12 to 5 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
